title: Nonprofit food bank in an existing donated building — San Juan, zone X
description: We are forming a nonprofit food bank in San Juan that will operate from a donated existing building. No construction; volunteers and two staff.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
Nonprofit: Hacienda exemption under s.1101.01 Codigo de Rentas Internas. (KB: RULE_0686, RULE_0687)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction in the description: RULE_0643-0646 need project_type new_construction/renovation, structural_work or construction_approvals_required.
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No alcohol: RULE_0013/0014 need Q_ALCOHOL_SOLD / Q_ALCOHOL_SERVED; the business-type alcohol rules exist only for Bar / Juice Bar.
